# اُسْتُمْطِرَا (ustumṭirā) /us.tum.tˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# اِسْتَمْطِرَا (istamṭirā) /is.tam.tˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
